body.name: Focal-dyad difference in means
body.construction: For \(z\in H(a,b)\) and \(q_0\in\mathbb R^{U_P}\), \(D_z(q_0)=\frac{\sum_{\ell:z_\ell=1}\sum_{(i,j)\in B_\ell\times S_\ell}q_{0,ij}}{\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}a_\ell b_\ell z_\ell}-\frac{\sum_{\ell:z_\ell=0}\sum_{(i,j)\in B_\ell\times S_\ell}q_{0,ij}}{\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}a_\ell b_\ell(1-z_\ell)}\).
